name: KITE
description: KITE is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the instruction-following abilities of large language models specifically in Korean, addressing linguistic and cultural nuances. It targets diverse, open-ended instruction-following tasks beyond factual or multiple-choice testing, combining automated and human evaluation.
reputation: A newer Korean instruction-following benchmark that is gaining attention in the Korean LLM community, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on Korean-specific linguistic features and cultural context for instruction-following evaluation.
